name: Will I need separate permits for plumbing and electrical work in my home addition in the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: Will I need separate permits for plumbing and electrical work in my home addition in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, typically separate permits are required for plumbing and electrical work, in addition to the overall building permit for your home addition in East Bay cities like Oakland or Berkeley. These permits ensure that all installations comply with local safety standards and codes. Our team at Frasheski Construction handles the permit application process for all necessary trades, coordinating with local planning departments to ensure your project meets all regulatory requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, separate permits for plumbing and electrical work are typically required in East Bay cities, and our team handles the application process for compliance.
